editorNote: The second full week of January finds the new year’s electronics trade-show talk moving into shop counters: home computers, cartridges, and practical office software all compete for the same household budget.
morningLine: After CES, buyers ask which machines, cartridges, and software boxes will still matter by spring.

lead.headline: CES Afterglow Puts Game Cartridges and Home Micros on the Same Counter
lead.summary: January trade coverage and the Computer Entertainer newsletter show publishers and dealers pushing ambitious 1983 game plans while personal computers keep claiming more shelf space beside consoles.
lead.confidence: Medium; grounded in January 1983 trade/newsletter coverage and broader early-1983 retail context.

computerItems.title: IBM PC software shelves keep growing
